name: function-call-cards
goal: Function list cards show linked example invocations instead of titles and descriptions, preserving revision scope and small responsive grids

evidence: Replace visible titles and descriptions with a clickable example invocation, using revision-owned samples or named parameters; preserve the compact open icon and responsive grid.

Existing card rendering and viewport grid scenarios asserted descriptions and omitted call syntax and values. Strengthen those shared cases with sample arguments, absent headings, revision links, falsy values and safe escaping.
